title: Stone2 듀오 #50 · hourglass bombshell / super hourglass · 석재 jade / 석재 turquoise · 미니멀 로프트 · 와인 레드립 / 비주얼계 블랙립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

#1: a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long curly teal hair
#1: Body Art: full body polished jade-green stone fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale-green cloudy vein striations flowing through every section, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved jade-green stone.
#1: Cracks: the jade-green stone body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left thigh, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left shoulder and one at her right forearm, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey-green stone with a rough waxy surface, much duller than the polished jade outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the jade-green stone is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
#1: Pose: both hands resting on her thighs, leaning slightly forward, one knee bent — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved jade-green stone right down to the shoes.
#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, carved from the same jade with a high polish.
#1: Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque matte deep wine-burgundy lips with a precise edge, soft bronze smoky eyeshadow, defined lashes.

#2: a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 50s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, sculpted updo platinum silver hair
#2: Body Art: full body polished turquoise fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING sky-blue turquoise surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID dark brown matrix webbing running through every section, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved turquoise.
#2: Cracks: the turquoise body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right upper arm, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left calf and one at her right hip, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw pale chalky blue-grey stone with a rough surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the turquoise is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
#2: Pose: both hands resting on her thighs, leaning slightly forward, one knee bent — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.

#2: Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

Environment: a bright minimalist loft studio with pale concrete floors, tall factory windows, a standard door and a row of normal chairs, soft daylight from one side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with the carved material covering every body from the collarbones to the shoes, shoulders, chest, arms and hands included, every element standing in true relief. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
